places.name: Visby City Wall
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, the Visby City Wall is a medieval fortification encircling the old town, offering a glimpse into history.

opening_hours.notes: Always accessible. Guided tours available during the day.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking along the wall.

places.name: Gotlands Museum
places.ai_summary: A treasure trove of Gotland’s history, showcasing artifacts, Viking relics, and medieval art.
places.place_tip: Check out the Viking exhibit for a unique experience.

attribution.title: Gotlands Museum (Fornsalen) logga (6)
attribution.author: W.carter
attribution.description: Gotland Museum, Fornsalen, logo and inner yard at Strandgatan, Visby, Gotland, Sweden.

places.name: St. Mary’s Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A stunning example of medieval architecture, St. Mary’s Cathedral is known for its beautiful altarpiece and impressive organ.

opening_hours.notes: Open for services and concerts; hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Attend a concert for a memorable experience.

attribution.title: Catedral de Santa María (Toomkirik), Tallin, Estonia, 2012-08-05, DD 09
attribution.author: Diego Delso
attribution.description: Cathedral of Saint Mary, Tallinn, Estonia

places.name: Almedalen Park
places.ai_summary: A picturesque park in the heart of Visby, Almedalen Park is perfect for a leisurely stroll or a picnic.

opening_hours.notes: Always accessible. Events and concerts during summer.

places.place_tip: Bring a blanket and enjoy a picnic.

attribution.title: Mr Bullitt - Almedalen i Visby
attribution.author: Mr Bullitt

places.name: Botaniska Trädgården
places.ai_summary: The Botanical Garden in Visby is a serene escape with a diverse range of plants, flowers, and themed gardens.
places.place_tip: Visit the rose garden and the tropical greenhouse.

attribution.title: Orto botanico di Pisa - general view
attribution.author: Daderot.
attribution.description: Orto botanico di Pisa - general view. Pisa, Italy.

places.name: St. Nicolai Ruin
places.ai_summary: The ruins of St. Nicolai Church offer a hauntingly beautiful glimpse into Visby’s medieval past.
places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding graveyard for more history.

attribution.title: The Nightmare
attribution.author: Henry Fuseli

places.name: Visby Old Town
places.ai_summary: A stroll through Visby Old Town is like stepping back in time, with its well-preserved medieval buildings and charming streets.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the medieval week in August.

places.name: Stora Torget Square
places.ai_summary: The main square in Visby, Stora Torget is surrounded by historic buildings and is a hub of activity.

opening_hours.notes: Always accessible. Events and markets held here.

places.place_tip: Try the local delicacies from market stalls.

places.name: DBW’s Botanical Garden
places.ai_summary: A beautiful botanical garden in Visby, DBW’s Botanical Garden features a wide variety of plants and themed garden areas.
places.place_tip: Visit the rock garden and the tropical greenhouse.

places.name: Gotland Art Museum
places.ai_summary: Showcasing contemporary and traditional art, the Gotland Art Museum is a cultural gem in Visby.
places.place_tip: Check the schedule for temporary exhibitions.

attribution.title: Gotlands Museum (Fornsalen) logga (6)
attribution.author: W.carter
attribution.description: Gotland Museum, Fornsalen, logo and inner yard at Strandgatan, Visby, Gotland, Sweden.

places.name: Lummelunda Cave
places.ai_summary: A fascinating natural attraction, Lummelunda Cave is known for its impressive stalactites, stalagmites, and underground river.
places.place_tip: Wear warm clothes; it's cool inside the cave.

places.name: Tofta Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular beach destination, Tofta Beach is known for its long sandy shores and clear waters, perfect for swimming and sunbathing.

opening_hours.notes: Always accessible. Lifeguards on duty during summer.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good spot.

attribution.title: Tofta, Gotland, Sweden (6149515870)
attribution.author: Berit from Redhill/Surrey, UK

places.name: Kneippbyn Amusement Park
places.ai_summary: A family-friendly destination, Kneippbyn Amusement Park offers rides, games, and attractions for all ages.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary; check the website for details.

places.place_tip: Buy tickets online to avoid queues.

places.name: Visby Town Hall
places.ai_summary: An important historical building, Visby Town Hall is known for its impressive architecture and beautiful courtyard.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed history.

places.name: Fornsal Historical Museum
places.ai_summary: The Fornsal Historical Museum offers insights into the Viking Age and medieval history of Gotland.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the medieval weapons exhibit.

attribution.title: Gotlands Museum (Fornsalen) logga (6)
attribution.author: W.carter
attribution.description: Gotland Museum, Fornsalen, logo and inner yard at Strandgatan, Visby, Gotland, Sweden.

places.name: Norderport City Gate
places.ai_summary: Norderport is one of the few remaining city gates in Visby, offering a glimpse into the medieval fortifications.
places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Botanical Garden.

attribution.title: Visby ringmur östra delen norrut
attribution.author: En-cas-de-soleil
attribution.description: East part of Visby City Wall towards the north and the Money Box. The two towers of Sankta Maria Cathedral can be seen behind the wall. Visby, Gotland, Sweden.

places.name: Visby Ramparts Walk
places.ai_summary: Walking the Visby Ramparts offers stunning views of the town and the sea, along with a dose of history.
places.place_tip: Start at the south end for the best views.

places.name: Högklint Cliff Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: For breathtaking views of the coastline and the Baltic Sea, Högklint Cliff Viewpoint is a must-visit.

opening_hours.notes: Always accessible. No facilities at the viewpoint.

places.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise or sunset for the best light
places.place_tip: Bring a camera and a tripod.

attribution.title: Visby galgberget 2009
attribution.author: Artifex
attribution.description: The old gallows in Visby, Sweden.

places.name: Söderport District
places.ai_summary: A charming district in Visby, Söderport is known for its narrow streets, medieval houses, and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Always accessible. Explore the small shops and cafes.

places.place_tip: Visit the local artisan shops.

places.name: Visby Marina
places.ai_summary: A picturesque marina in Visby, ideal for a leisurely walk, dining, and enjoying views of the boats and the sea.

opening_hours.notes: Always accessible. Restaurants and cafes may have varied hours.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at a waterfront restaurant.
